linked.scope: vendored inference core and first-party ring modifications

linked.name: nng
linked.scope: static TCP ring; TLS, HTTP, WS and WSS disabled; SHA1 excluded

excluded.fio: external_fio_impl replaced with conservative fixed bandwidth estimates; no subprocess
excluded.OpenMP: GGML_OPENMP=OFF on Linux/Darwin; ON on Windows with the compiler runtime shipped as a signed release asset
excluded.base64.hpp: Unlicense, only used by unbuilt llava-cli

system.linux: libc, libm, libpthread, libdl, libstdc++, libgcc runtime; captured by ldd per architecture
system.darwin: libSystem, libc++, Foundation/Metal/MetalKit on arm64; captured by otool -L
system.windows: Windows system DLLs plus the shipped clang libomp.dll; toolchain statically linked; captured per build by objdump import listing

audit_limit: C/C++ scanners cannot prove absence of vulnerabilities in a fork or recover vendored upstream ancestry. License scan covers verified compiler dependency files from all five target builds plus Metal source; SBOM includes file hashes. Grype and OSV reports are time-specific database evidence, not a claim of complete vulnerability knowledge.
